To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) the treatment of uncertainty in expert systems can be achieved by using the theory of possibility; 2) the treatment of imprecise information is achieved by using the concept of a possibility distribution; 3) the treatment of both imprecise and uncertain information is achieved by combining the theory of possibility and the concept of a fuzzy possibility distribution.
a medical expert system can be built using possibility theory, and that this theory is a powerful tool for dealing with imprecision and uncertainty in medical knowledge.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a medical decision-aid expert system for the treatment of type I diabetes mellitus in children and teenagers.
the development of medical knowledge bases, which are based on the theory and methods of possibility theory and which can be used for decision-aid in medicine.
the following questions: How can the knowledge of medical experts be represented in a computerized system in such a way that it is possible to use this knowledge in the treatment of patients?
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the theory of possibility provides an adequate and efficient tool for the representation and treatment of imprecision and uncertainty in the field of medical decision making.
the theory of possibility is a very promising tool for the treatment and representation of imprecise knowledge.
, for this application, the theory of possibility appears to provide a very satisfactory solution to the problem of representing imprecision and uncertainty in the framework of an expert system.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the imprecision of the medical knowledge is dealt with using the theory of possibility and the uncertainty using the theory of probability.
imprecise and uncertain knowledge is handled by a possibility distribution, which can be used to calculate an imprecise and/or uncertain conclusion.
we have been able to show the possibility of the use of the theory of possibility as a framework for the treatment of imprecise and uncertain medical knowledge.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the use of possibility theory for dealing with imprecision and uncertainty in medical expert systems is a viable alternative to the more usual probabilistic approaches.
the possibility theory is a good framework for the treatment of imprecise medical data and for the management of uncertainty in medical diagnosis.
the theory of possibility provides a very useful framework for dealing with imprecision in medical knowledge.
